result.notes: Method: headless Chrome 0=new driven over raw CDP from Node 24 (no puppeteer-core or playwright-core exists in any worktree and I did not download one); one Chrome at a time, temp profile deleted each run; chrome-devtools MCP, Claude in Chrome and the Browser pane never used. Free RAM dropped under 1200 MB several times, so I waited before launches. All clicks were real pointer events after elementFromPoint hit tests; every capture opened and judged. 143 captures in C:\Users\atish\Desktop\mockmob copy\mockmob-next\tmp\web-audit-1017\today-progress-colleges-account\. Only the website dev server (3263) was used; the landing server (3122) was not needed for these items. Caveats: the dev server is not production speed; signed-in views are the /preview/arena fixtures; the on-screen keyboard and real sign-in persistence cannot be tested headless. Nothing was edited, committed, stashed or touched in any database.
